notes.title: Ukranian Games Festival: New Demo, New Trailer
notes.content:
[p][b]OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENT[/b][/p][p]Comrades, [i]MINISTRY OF TRUTH: 1984[/i] is taking part in the [b]Ukrainian Games Festival - [/b]a large-scale initiative celebrating the future of the Ukrainian gaming industry. The festival, organized by [url="https://Palaye.net"]Palaye.net[/url], starts on August 14.[/p][p]For this occasion, we have prepared a [b]new, expanded demo version[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]More situations[/b] to test your loyalty.[/p][/*][*][p][b]More mini-games[/b] to train vigilance and discipline.[/p][/*][*][p][b]A storyline[/b] that is rational and tightly connected.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expanded settings[/b] for the comfort of every citizen.[/p][/*][*][p][b]German translation[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]We have also released [b]new audio-visual propaganda (trailer)[/b] — watch and evaluate our efforts.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614063/60f32de4a5dd3ee93d673691149f79ee842e991a.png"][/img][/p][p]🎮 Download the demo, add the game to your wishlist, and remember: [b]Truth exists only under control.[/b][/p][p]Comrades, the festival also features many unique projects from talented Ukrainian developers. Support their work, spread the propaganda, and show loyalty to the Ukrainian gaming industry.[/p][p]Sincerely,
— [i]False Memory Dept.[/i][/p]

notes.title: Debut Festival
notes.content:
[p][b]OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENT[/b][/p][p]We proudly report: [i]MINISTRY OF TRUTH: 1984[/i] has been selected to participate in the [b]Debut Festival[/b] - a grand initiative celebrating the future of game development and the rise of new voices in interactive storytelling.[/p][p]Side by side with other promising first titles, it stands as a testament to discipline, vision, and the power of ideological clarity. The Festival, orchestrated by [b]GameDev.ist[/b], commences on [b]August 7th[/b].[/p][p]A new, enhanced demo version will be released next week. Until then, play the current version and add the game to your wishlist. Every loyal action matters.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614063/18f042abae1ce57fc1cb73d43d3838055cbde510.png"][/img][/p][p]Comrades, do not stand aside. Join us — witness the birth of a new era in gaming.[/p][p][b]The truth is not a matter of opinion. It is a matter of control.[/b][/p][p]Sincerely,
— [i]False Memory Dept.[/i][/p]
